# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability in Fennec

Please **do not** open a public issue for security vulnerabilities.

Instead, use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting:
**[Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/Fennec-AI/Fennec/security/advisories/new)**
(the *Security* tab → *Report a vulnerability*). We'll acknowledge your report
and work with you on a fix and coordinated disclosure.

## Supported versions

Fennec is pre-1.0 and moves quickly. Security fixes land on `main` and ship in
the next release; please report against the latest `main` or release.

| Version | Supported |
|---------|-----------|
| latest `main` / release | ✅ |
| older releases | ❌ |

## Using Fennec responsibly

Fennec is an **offensive** security tool. Only point it at systems you own or
have explicit written authorization to test. Running it against third-party
systems without permission may be illegal. You are responsible for how you use
it — see the "Authorized testing only" notice in the [README](../README.md).
